Name: PolyamorySweet
Author: ApryllForever
Description:
[center][font=Tahoma][size=5]Introduction[/size][/font][/center]
Multiplayer:

﻿Compatible, but note: Host Cannot marry Farmhand after Host marries NPCs, will cause a wedding every morning bug (Marry Farmhands first). 
﻿If Farmhand marries one of Hosts's spouses, the wedding will play fine for the Farmhand, will be a little odd for the host, but overall everything works. Also, the spouse will still live in the host's house, and will perhaps have dialogue issues (the game gets pretty confused about how the two of you relate, ﻿and where the spouse is supposed to be).
﻿
[font=Arial]
Permits multiple spouses or roommates, allows multiple spouses at weddings, and also, unlimited hugging and kissing!!! Also custom bed size, which you can set in the config!!!! For Stardew 1.6. Compatible with SVE, RSV, ES, ARV, and any other expansion with datable NPC's! 

Dating and proposal work the same as usual.

To select primary spouse, simply give the [color=#ff00ff][size=5]Áine Flower[/size][/color] to your spouse! Purchasable from Pierre's, and also may be planted with seeds from Pierre's, spring through fall. 

Your spouses will join you at the wedding!

Bed order may be set in the config! Bed size may also be set in the config, or by default it goes by number of spouses or 3, whichever is larger.

You can kiss your spouse/roommate multiple times a day, as many as you like! Also, they will kiss each other! There is a config to select for relatives to not kiss. 

Custom Rooms for each spouse! The spouse room will not show up until after you exit and re-enter the game. This is intended, as it avoids a game crash. Further details to be written.
[/font]
[center][font=Arial][size=6]Details[/size]
[/font][/center]
[font=Arial]Below you will find specifics for each of the mods. I have the mods modularized to permit player/end user modularization and selections. You will find the configs for each inside their specific folder. 

﻿Those listed with true or false will take only true or false as an option, no quotation marks.
﻿Those listed with numbers and the word integer take a whole positive number zero or greater. (Just not greater than 2,147,483,647 ! )
﻿Those listed with numbers and the word percentage take a whole number between zero and 100.
﻿Each heart is 250 friendship points.
[/font]
[center][font=Arial][size=5]Additions:[/size][/font][/center]
[font=Arial]Lantana: Non-Datable NPC, runs a small shop in Lantana Lagoon, which sells items for this mod.
Lantana Lagoon: A small area accessible via Minecarts, once the Minecart system ahs been opened. 
Items:
﻿  ﻿- Mermaid Bouquet: Used to ask to date someone.
﻿  ﻿- Atagartis Pendant: Used to propose marriage.
﻿  ﻿- Roomie B Gone: Used to kick a roommate out of the house.

These items do not supplant the Bouquet or the Mermaid Pendant; those are both available in game and still do the same thing. These have been added because some players are having significant issues proposing with vanilla items, this circumvents the game code for those items, allowing a smoother game-play. 

Aphrodite Flower: give to a spouse. Lets u make a baby with them. When you give someone the flower, that night it will trigger the baby question with that person. This flower is named for Aphrodite, Goddess of Love and War.

Lilith Token: give this to one child, to dove them. Irreversible. Named for Lilith, the Goddess of Unwanted Children, the first woman, the lesbian who rejected patriarchy for independence. Abigail loves this gift tho! 

[/font]
[center][font=Arial][size=5]Polyamory Sweet Love[/size]
[/font][/center]
[font=Arial]Permits you to marry multiple spouses and/or have multiple roommates. 

Configs:

  Mod Enabled:
﻿Select whether or not to enable the mod. Will not run if disabled. Default true;
 
  Buy Pendants Anytime :
﻿Purchase pendants at the beach anytime. Default false;

 Pendant Price: 
﻿Price of how much the Mermaid Pendant costs. Integer. Default = 5000;

  Min Points To Marry:
The minimum number of points to marry. Integer. Default = 2500;

  Min Points To Date.
﻿The minimum number of points to date. Integer. Default = 2000;

  Prevent Hostile Divorces:
﻿After divorce, ex-spouse remains friendly with player, will still receive gifts. Default false;

  Complex Divorces:
﻿Adds an additional divorce dialogue answer, "It's Complicated", allowing the player to explain reasons for the divorce. (Player may select what they will,    ﻿depending on what is selected, will affect number of hearts lost or cost.) Default true;

  Roommate Romance:
Allows romantic relationship with characters who would otherwise move in as roommates only (such as Krobus). ﻿Default false;

  Romance All Villagers:
Will allow one to propose to and marry all adults. Will disable shops if you marry a shop owner. ﻿Default false;

  Gay Pregnancies:
﻿Select whether to have a birth or to adopt for a same-sex marriage. Default true, because we gay people have LOTS of ways of getting pregnant,    ﻿including that trans people exist!!

  Max Children:
Sets the maximum number of children. Integer. ﻿Default = 2;

  Show Parent Names:
Show parent's name after child's name in the lists. Default ﻿true;

  Spouse Sleep Order:
﻿Write the spouse names you want in between the quotation marks. For example "Abigail, Leah, Haley, Marisol, Alla, Sophia". Default is whatever order ﻿you marry the spouses in;

  Percent Chance For Spouse to be In Bed:
Chance the spouse will be in bed on day start. Percentage. Default ﻿25;

  Percent Chance For Spouse To Be In Kitchen:
Chance the spouse will be in bed on day start. Percentage. Default ﻿25:

  Percent Chance For Spouse To Be In Patio:
﻿Chance the spouse will be in bed on day start. Percentage. Default ﻿25.

  Percent Chance For Pregnancy Question:
﻿Chance that a spouse will ask to make a baby with you. Decimal. Default 0.05. 

  Percent Chance For Child Sex:
﻿Chance that your child will be a girl or boy. Decimal. Default 0.6.

 Impregnating Mother: 
﻿ True or False of whether a female farmer is able to get the wife pregnant. Will make all children girls. Can be circumvented using just Allow Gay Pregnancies.

Impregnating Femme NPC:
﻿True or false of if the female farmer's wife can get her pregnant.

[/font]
[center][font=Arial][size=5]Polyamory Sweet Rooms[/size][/font][/center]
[font=Arial]NPC mod authors, simply add the spouse rooms to your NPC per vanilla instructions. Content packs are in, but do not make them the default, all spouses should have the basic spouse room data added to their creation file. [/font]




[center][size=5]Commands:[/size][/center]

If you are somehow having difficulty with proposals, type one of these commands into your SMAPI console to do what the description shows! Mostly, only use these as a last resort. Attempt is fairly safe. Force is very risky, and can easily crash the game if your house is the wrong upgrade size, you try to get engaged to more than one person at once, etc.

[color=#ff00ff][size=4]proposal_sweet_Attempt X[/size][/color] : Attempts to propose to someone. Instead of X, place the name of the person you want to marry (proposal_sweet Attempt Abigail). Please note this bypasses some in-game safety features, and may cause crashes or other errors.

[color=#ff00ff][size=4]proposal_sweet_Force X[/size][/color]: Sets the NPC as engaged. Will only permit proposing to adult characters. (cannot propose to green slimes, sorry!). Will also require your house to be upgraded. This should may cause many possible errors! (May crash easily, use as last resort!) 

[color=#ff00ff][size=4]﻿delete_weddings[/size][/color]: Deletes any upcoming weddings. In general, for an NPC, you can just give them a wilted bouquet. However, if that is not working, this will work. This is made specifically for the perpetual wedding bug.


[center][size=5]﻿NPC Mod Authors:[/size][/center]
Mod Authors: to cause your character to not receive the Atagartis Pendant or Mermaid Pendant, write PSLIgnore in the NPC's CustomFields. Also, please inform your users of this, to reduce my overall why-won't-this-npc-take-the-pendant reports! Thx!
